title: Hernia Surgery Urinary Retention
brief_summary: Investigating whether pre-operative treatment with a selective alpha1-adrenoceptor antagonist affects the likelihood of male patients developing post-operative urinary retention following hernia repair.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male
* 18 years of age
* Presenting with hernia requiring surgical intervention

Exclusion Criteria:

* Intolerability of tamsulosin or related drugs
* Investigator discretion
* Unwillingness or inability to comply with protocol procedures and assessments
